label: Sfx: Lodestone's cast, touch and close arms, before the shared rune-crack fallback
why: The three voices (v70 §6.2), in the synth only. The arms are added BEFORE the shared rune-crack fallback, and the fallback line is re-emitted unchanged, so the relics that still fall through keep it (12 others on this link). Through the patched play() every arm reproduces its lab candidate (worst 6e-08; the touch at counts -1, 0, 1-5, 7 and a missing n, on two noise draws), 126 other voices are unchanged (worst 1e-07), and ult/lodestone is no longer rune-crack. play() returns on its first line with no audio context (every headless run), draws no random number and writes nothing the simulation reads; end to end the three voices through the patched page's own SFX.play equal the candidates (worst 6e-08); with Bindweed's, Coldiron's, Portcullis's and Ironhail's Sfx rows (the batch's scratch builds) applied too, in either order, every arm of both renders alike.

label: tickRunes: the touch voice and the hex-snap under it, once per touch, after its hex
why: Two plain SFX.play calls in tickRunes's hex branch, after the apply and the tally, so n is the count the foe now carries (foe.stacks is a read) and the hex-snap is heard whenever the touch hexes (reading 2). 4894/4894 touches voiced and 4894 hex-snaps, each n equal to the foe's count (1-5; 70% at 5; a stack added on 1851, the cap refreshed on 3043); 152/152 fights identical and every other SFX call identical in order and opts; the same rows plus one sim write (the foe nudged 1e-9 on a touch) come back 4/152; end to end, the rows applied as text to a copy of the page: 76/76 fights identical to the unpatched page's.

label: tickRunes: the close, when the window runs out by its clock with both fighters alive
why: One guarded SFX.play BEFORE the close line, which is re-emitted unchanged: a clock close with both fighters alive (Z.t >= Z.dur is the line's own clock test, read after its own increment). 478 close voices for 478 clock closes; none for the 12 death closes or the 75 windows still lit at the verdict (tickRunes is not called once the fight is over); nothing is read back; end to end, the rows applied as text to a copy of the page: 76/76 fights identical to the unpatched page's.
